facts.value: European Studies at the University of Limerick is a broad and integrated world-class programme that allows students an in-depth opportunity to study European languages and policy, equipping them with highly sought-after digital and research skills.
It is the only European Studies programme in Ireland which includes Irish as one of its language options.

Brexit means more direct interaction with the EU and with individual member states on the continent. A better knowledge of the European Union, and Ireland’s place within it, is more needed than ever before.
An understanding of Europe requires knowledge of its historical origins, economic, legal, societal aspects, and political institutions.
The University of Limerick has long led the way in Ireland in this field, resulting in this degree being one of the longest established European Studies degree programmes in Europe.
